description: This file contains utility functions for handling Kubernetes bootstrap secrets, including data retrieval, expiration checks, name parsing, and group validation.

methods.name: GetData
methods.description: Returns the string value for a given key in a Kubernetes Secret object, or an empty string if not found.

methods.name: HasExpired
methods.description: Determines whether a Kubernetes Secret has expired based on its expiration timestamp.

methods.name: GetExpiration
methods.description: Checks if the secret has an expiration timestamp, returns the remaining time and whether it is expired.

methods.name: ParseName
methods.description: Parses the secret name to extract the secret ID based on a predefined pattern.

methods.name: GetGroups
methods.description: Loads and validates bootstrap token groups from a secret, returning a list of group names.
